mechanism: Treat current-bar tick volume V as a trading-intensity proxy vs mean tick volume V_avr of the last K closed candles (iVolumes VOLUME_TICK). Open only when V exceeds the average by a relative deviation: V > V_avr*(1+D) for the first order (D=signalDeviation). Direction follows current-candle price change (BUY_STOP if close>open else SELL_STOP).
data_needed: iVolumes VOLUME_TICK buffer length K; current bar open/close; params K,D
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP PERIOD_H1 optimized 2018–2023; strategy designed for any symbol/TF on hedge accounts
why_new_for_mis: Explicit tick-volume surge-vs-baseline sensor for activity/liquidity intensity, not just price momentum—usable as a quiet-vs-active market gate.
quote: A larger tick volume will be considered a sign of more intense trading. ... V > V_avr * (1 + D + N * D_add)

mechanism: Stack additional pending/market entries only as intensity climbs further: threshold becomes V > V_avr*(1+D+N*D_add) where N is current open orders+positions and D_add is a separate add-on deviation. Caps at N_max so each successive fill demands a higher tick-volume excess over the rolling mean.
data_needed: same iVolumes series; live count of own magic orders/positions N; D, D_add, N_max
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1; hedge-account independent positions; defaults N_max=3
why_new_for_mis: Turns a single volume spike into a graded intensity ladder—MIS can emit ordinal activity levels (0..N_max) instead of a binary surge flag.
quote: Let’s make two independent parameters D and D_add for the first and subsequent orders ... V > V_avr * (1 + D + N * D_add)

mechanism: When the tick-volume excess condition fires, classify short-horizon directional regime from the incomplete candle: if iOpen < iClose → buy-stop continuation; else sell-stop. Idea premise: intensification plus directional move implies near-term continuation vs sluggish trading.
data_needed: current-bar open/close; volume-excess flag from SignalForOpen
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1 (and later multi-FX H1 instances); PERIOD_CURRENT in EA
why_new_for_mis: Couples liquidity-intensity detection with intrabar polarity into a micro continuation-regime label usable as an entry filter.
quote: if we see that trading has intensified and the price has changed in some direction, then perhaps it will change in the same direction in the near future.

mechanism: Run with oversized deposit and min lot; record absolute drawdown D and profit P at lot L; for allowed drawdown Da compute La=L*(Da/D) and Pa=P*(Da/D). Use La as the risk-normalized size so each strategy instance targets a fixed DD budget (e.g. 10% of $10k).
data_needed: tester max absolute DD and profit at fixed lot; target Da; starting deposit
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1 two optimized param sets; $100k then $10k calibration examples
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a historical-path risk-capacity feature: map observed DD into a normalized exposure scale before combining sensors/strategies.

mechanism: Strategies only open CVirtualOrder virtual positions; CVolumeReceiver sums Volume() across all strategy instances per symbol into newVolumes[], diffs vs live market net volume, then opens/closes/partials so real exposure equals net virtual demand. Opposite virtual longs/shorts cancel before hitting the market.
data_needed: per-strategy virtual order arrays; symbol list; live PositionsTotal net volume; CorrectPosition helpers
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP, GBPUSD, EURUSD PERIOD_H1; nine strategy instances; hedge and netting accounts
why_new_for_mis: Portfolio-level net-exposure sensor/actuator: MIS can treat summed multi-strategy virtual volume as a consensus directional intensity per symbol.
quote: For each symbol used, go through all the strategies and calculate the total open volume for each symbol used.

mechanism: Each of nine H1 instances is pre-sized for ~10% solo DD; when run together, scale all lots by shared depoPart_ (e.g. 0.38) so joint equity DD stays near the $1000 budget. Empirically joint Sharpe rose ~1.3→2.84 at same DD vs solos—senses diversification benefit of concurrent volume-surge instances across symbols.
data_needed: per-instance fitted lots; shared depoPart_; joint tester equity DD
why_new_for_mis: Cross-symbol shared drawdown budget is a simple multi-asset risk-regime scaler MIS can attach when fusing many similar intensity sensors.
quote: If depoPart_ = 0.38, the drawdown remains within acceptable limits. ... increase in the Sharpe ratio from 1.3 to 2.84.

mechanism: CVirtualSymbolReceiver keeps only open virtual orders for one symbol; Open/Close append/remove and set m_isChanged. CVirtualReceiver::Correct runs symbol Correct() only when m_isChanged and IsTradeAllowed (terminal/account trade flags). VirtualOrder::Tick checks virtual SL/TP each tick and closes, notifying receiver/strategy.
data_needed: virtual order open/close events; SL/TP vs bid/ask; trade-allowed flags

mechanism: At each new D1 bar, set daily base balance/equity and daily level = max(balance, equity). Daily profit = equity − daily level. When dailyProfit < −DailyLoss() (fixed $, % of base balance, or % of daily level), set CMoney::DepoPart(0) to flatten real positions while leaving virtual strategy positions open; restore DepoPart next day.
data_needed: ACCOUNT_BALANCE/EQUITY; IsNewBar D1; rm calc-limit enum + max daily loss param

quote: Daily level is the maximum of the daily base balance and funds. ... when the maximum daily loss is reached, all open market positions will be closed.

mechanism: When RM flattens market positions via DepoPart=0, virtual orders stay open. VirtualProfit() sums CMoney::Profit over CVirtualReceiver orders (scaled to trading funds) so the EA can still observe what floating P&L would be if real size matched virtual size—used to judge reopen quality vs actual closed path.
data_needed: open virtual orders; CMoney::Coeff/Profit; receiver OrdersTotal
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same model strategy tests; H1 logging of VirtualProfit vs real Profit/Daily Profit
why_new_for_mis: Shadow mark-to-market of the strategy book while risk-off is a counterfactual equity sensor MIS can use to separate strategy edge from RM intervention cost.
quote: even in the absence of real open positions, we can at any time estimate what the approximate profit would be if the real positions closed by the risk manager remained open.

mechanism: Track m_baseHWBalance = max(balance) and m_baseHWEquityBalance = max(equity,balance,prior HW). Overall profit vs base or HW via ENUM_RM_CALC_OVERALL_LOSS (money/% to BB, HW balance, or HW equity/balance). Separate overall-profit limit can force RM_STATE_OVERALL_PROFIT and zero DepoPart (prop target-stop).
data_needed: running balance/equity; chosen calc enum; max overall loss/profit params

mechanism: Instead of binary flatten, multiply m_dailyDepoPart (or m_overallDepoPart) by (1−closePart) when equity loss reaches DailyLoss()*(1−m_dailyDepoPart*(1−closeDailyPart)). Repeat (halve again at next fractional threshold); if multiplier <0.05 set to 0. SetDepoPart = baseDepoPart*daily*overall scales all real volumes—smooth risk-off regime ladder.
data_needed: daily/overall profit vs limits; closeDailyPart/closeOverallPart; baseDepoPart
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same multi-group EA; tests with closePart=0.5 vs full close; scale_=1 and 3
why_new_for_mis: Graduated drawdown→exposure multiplier is an explicit multi-state risk regime sensor (full→½→¼→off) MIS can fuse with market sensors.
quote: if we set m_closeDailyPart = 0.5, then when the loss reaches half of the daily limit, the position sizes will be halved.

mechanism: After daily limit, enter RM_STATE_RESTORE; restore DepoPart only when m_virtualProfit <= RestoreVirtualProfit(), where threshold = lastVirtualProfit * lastVirtualProfitFactor * (1 − t/maxRestoreTime) and t is minutes since restore start (linear decay to accepting worse fills). At t≥maxRestoreTime (or factor path), reopen even if virtual P&L improved.
data_needed: m_lastVirtualProfit at limit hit; maxRestoreTime minutes; lastVirtualProfitFactor; live VirtualProfit()
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Tests with maxRestoreTime=1440, factor=1.5; scale_ 1–10 on 2021–2022
